title: Contract-preserving local escape from frozen shared policy
scope: Retrospective source intervention on R118/R119 exact matched research arms, not independent F38 or actual maintainer authority.
rights: Global parser and type source immutable. Only content_charset.go may be changed. Compare no edit, local parser bypass and conditional fallback; candidate selection fixed before new Go execution.
goal: Type behavior equal to shared global starting state; charset behavior equal to independent base on a finite cross-product of raw header, allowed list and body; both frozen R118 tests retained. Preserve composed middleware in both orders, with no new behavior beyond those target component predicates.
predictions: No edit fails divergent charset; direct local parse succeeds by restoring historical independent contentEncoding body; conditional fallback on shared rejection succeeds if it rechecks original MIME parsing and handles missing charset; both cost one changed file. G remains exact bytes. Failure of any case falsifies candidate for this declared oracle.
cost: File visits, changed lines, and introduced duplicate parser callsites are distinct. No inferred human cost or global minimality. Counterexample to extending prior toggle-menu unreachability beyond its grammar.
next: Compare two-step lifecycle cost with and without local escape; count independent extra requirements and coordination costs separately.
